[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (63.5→64.4) + Neutral zone consolidation: Sideways movement before overbought entry.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-13.1530→-15.4415) + Continued worsening: Bullish momentum weakening.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $2,546.1, Middle $2,471.25): Consolidating near the middle band, band width contracted to 6.06%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($2,530.44) + Basis (Just below current price, close to Pivot S1).
· Swing Resistance ($2,545.62) + Potential for strengthened short-term bullish momentum upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Consolidation) + Trend reversal confirmation needed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.43x 5-day average) + Increased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Short-term adjustment within uptrend) + Entry condition: Consider buying upon confirmation of RSI recovery above 50 and MACD improvement.
